__doc__: Add-on registry for the TBW toolbox. Each add-on installs over root SSH from a *kit* folder you stage from that project's own release (no third-party binaries are shipped here). 'steps' are remote shell commands; {stage} = uploaded kit on the HU, {backup} = on-device backup dir. An add-on with no 'steps' installs as 'pending' until verified on a reference car. Credits/licenses: ../../NOTICES.md.

nbt-aad.name: Android Auto (NBT-AAD)
nbt-aad.desc: Wireless Android Auto for NBT Evo (ID5/ID6). The base the tile and iDrive Plus build on.

aa-menu-tile.name: Android Auto main-menu tile
aa-menu-tile.desc: Standalone tile that reuses the CarLife entry so Android Auto shows on the home screen; press brings AA to the front. ~14KB, boot-started.
aa-menu-tile.credit: deathwalker80 - nbt-aa-tile; mechanism by RRudkinp; NBT-AAD by Sq00ky
aa-menu-tile.verify_hint: Android Auto (NBT-AAD) must be installed and running first (its state file /dev/shmem/nbt-aad-state was not found)

idrive-plus-plugins.name: iDrive Plus (info pages)
idrive-plus-plugins.desc: Weather/news/fuel/traffic/vehicle-status pages inside iDrive via the AA Wi-Fi. HU plugins install here; the phone app is sideloaded separately. News/fuel/traffic data is Italy-only as shipped.
idrive-plus-plugins.verify_hint: Android Auto (NBT-AAD) must be installed and running first (its state file /dev/shmem/nbt-aad-state was not found)

entry-aad.name: Wireless Android Auto (EntryNav2)
entry-aad.desc: Wireless Android Auto for EntryNav2 (1280x480, CarPlay Wi-Fi). Installs /opt/aa + /opt/hmi/data/ro/Plugins/EntryAad; built-in compat check; reversible. Needs the HU root password (EntryNav2 roots differently from NBT Evo). Alt: kizapp/entrynav2-idrive6-android-auto (GPL-3.0).
entry-aad.credit: Jiraiya43 - entry-aad (port of Sq00ky's NBT-AAD); alt: kizapp
